explication: This repository contains three experimental assistant products rather than one shared runtime: an Android voice assistant, a Windows voice-command/desktop-automation script, and an early vision prototype. The documented user workflow is to speak a request, have the platform-specific assistant interpret it, and receive speech or an action. Android capabilities are documented but its source was not sampled; Windows relationships below follow visible calls in Jarvis.py. The Vision branch is kept at the documented prototype level because its implementation was not sampled.
